flags: AlphaSimplex Group LLC is an SEC-registered institutional investment management firm, not an AI software tool or SaaS product; its products are investment funds (managed futures and global macro ETFs). This listing describes an investment manager rather than an AI tool buyers can adopt.

Older descriptions state AlphaSimplex 'is an affiliate of Natixis Investment Managers', which is incorrect as of 2026. The firm is now 'a Virtus Investment Partner' following its acquisition by Virtus Investment Partners.

AlphaSimplex uses quantitative and systematic methods (some incorporating machine learning) internally to manage investment strategies, but it does not offer any AI tool, API, or software platform to end users or businesses.
The 'Web App' access method refers to a client portal for existing institutional investors, not a general AI tool available to the public.
No IT security certifications such as SOC 2 or ISO 27001 were found. The firm's regulatory registrations (SEC, CFTC) are financial registrations, not information security certifications.
No bug bounty program was found on HackerOne or Bugcrowd.
